# A Shepherd's Presence in Troubled Times

## Matthew 9:36 (NIV)

"...When he saw the crowds, he had compassion on them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd."

## Reflection

As we navigate the complexities of life, we're often reminded of the fragility of our circumstances. In moments of uncertainty and fear, we can easily lose sight of God's presence and care. But Jesus saw beyond the surface and had compassion on those in need. He recognized their desperation, their sense of being lost and helpless. In the same way, He sees us – our struggles, our fears, and our doubts. We're not alone in our turmoil; we're not forgotten. Jesus is the Good Shepherd, always nearby, always watching, and always ready to intervene. His presence is a reminder that we're not orphans, but beloved children of God. He'll guide us through the darkest of times, and lead us to peace.

## Prayer

We confess, Lord, that we often feel lost and helpless in our struggles. We ask that you would remind us of your presence and care. Help us to trust in your guidance and provision, and to find peace in the midst of turmoil.

## One-Line Application

May we trust Jesus' presence in the midst of life's challenges.
